Money math: cheaper clicks make winners profitable at lower conversion rates; the hard part is native-sounding Spanish scripts (truncated).
idea: Geo-arbitrage the podcast format — run it in Spanish where the feed hasn't fatigued on it.
sequencing: Observation: the LatAm feed hasn't seen the format.
Generate full Spanish podcast ads with AI.
Cheaper clicks = profitable at lower CVR.
formatting: Photo attached; AI podcast video format.
why_it_works: Format fatigue is geographic — a tired format in the US is novel in LatAm, and cheaper CPMs widen the profit window.
what_to_steal: The fatigue-arbitrage principle for LC — when podcast ads fatigue in the US, port winners to new geos/audiences rather than killing them.

product: commentary — no product. Argues for "ads that don't look like ads"; cites a pet brand scaling $29K→$150K/mo with CPA $188→$124.
hook: "Just run ads that don't look like ads."
body: Critiques four account-building blocks: identical UGC (Andromeda dedupes 50 near-identical videos into one ad), over-polished ads (dead in frame one), discount statics (train sale-waiting), influencer whitelisting (paying for someone else's audience). The alternative: podcast clips, street interviews, skits with studio actors. Proof: pet brand $29K→$150K/mo spend in 60 days, CPA $188→$124. (Truncated.)
idea: Build the account on formats the feed doesn't recognize as ads — Andromeda punishes sameness.
why_it_works: Andromeda's deduping means format diversity isn't creative vanity — it's media efficiency.
what_to_steal: Podcast clips as LC's "doesn't look like an ad" pillar; the Andromeda-dedupe argument for format diversity.
